# Game Rules
Game rules apply specifically to the Game Server.
## Game Rule 0 We promote exploration of character narratives that other higher population servers may not allow. As such, some rules may be allowed to be waived if it pushes stories. - Any rules that may be waived under this clause will say “Follows GR0” - Two-way consent must be formed for this clause to take effect. Admins may ask for proof of consent if it was formed outside of the game. - Unless stated otherwise, utilizing GR0 is a temporary measure with a clear goal and one attempt at it.
## AHelp Relay & Ban Evasion You may use the AHelp relay to ask for clarification on any topic or to ask the admins to act in their capacity as game masters (See “Game Mastering Expectations”.) as well as to report rulebreaks or to note offputting behaviour. - Do not disconnect while being AHelped unless you have been asked to or are certain it is done. - Do not use multiple Space Station 14 accounts.
## No Exploits Do not utilize systems or mechanics that are not intended, such as intentionally clipping or bypassing mechanical limits.
It can be difficult to tell what is and is not an exploit, and as such it may be left to the discretion of the Admin presiding over the round. If you disagree, you may calmly ask for a second opinion.
If a second opinion cannot be obtained, or the second opinion agrees, you must cease to perform the action.
### Nonexhaustive List of Banned Exploits - Subframing - Tiny shuttles without IFF - Grappling Hook Clipping
## No EORG
Do not engage in antagonistic behaviour or IC crimes after the End Of Round screen has popped up.
Security similarly is not allowed to arrest or restrain anyone at that time. The Brig at Central Command can only be used as stated by the ISG or by the Admins or with explicit consent of the brigged player.
The End Of Round is still In Character, and serves to allow players to wind down and wrap up any narrative threads from the round. A repeated pattern of behaviour of being disruptive to End Of Round roleplay and narrative may constitute EORG.
Do not bring Artifacts, Canisters, Hydroponics Trays, or Explosives onto the Evacuation Shuttle or to Central Command.
## SSD Players SSD Players are characters whose players are away from their keyboard or offline, notified either by in-game identifiers or through a message in the OOC channel.
SSD Players are not valid targets for antagonistic behaviour, and should not be disrupted. Dragging them to a safer location, putting them in cryosleep, or arresting them are allowed.
## Narrative First Gameplay Box Station is an MRP+ Server.
Do not Play to Win, Do not Powergame. Space Station 14 is a collaborative roleplay experience where all players work together to create round-spanning narratives, including Security and Antagonists.
We are all here to have fun, do not let your enjoyment come at the direct expense of other players.
### No Roundstalling “Roundstalling” is a specific category of play-to-win behaviours that prevent the round from ending while also cutting off most players from engaging with the game or round.
It covers but is not limited to: - Preventing Nukies from winning by hiding the Nuke or by taking the disk into space - Recalling the shuttle after it was voted for the round to end without relevant objectives or silicon laws - Evading active pursuit in space as the lone or primary antagonist of a round - Rendering the shuttle uncallable
## No Metacomms Do not share current round information. The OOC channel is open for the express purpose of teaching, collaborating on roleplay at long distances, marking your ssd status, but not to metacomm.
Keep IC information in-character, and OOC information or check-ins in OOC or LOOC.
## Game Mastering Expectations BoxStation shifts only occur when there is an admin presence to facilitate them. As such, and our focus on lower pop narrative within MRP, admins also act as part-time Game Masters.
In this capacity, Admins are encouraged to unobtrusively support pre-existing narratives, ensure that rounds are able to start, and other such responsibilities.
### Bluespace Power Relay In the event of there being no Engineering Staff, Admins will initiate a “Bluespace Power Relay” to keep the station powered. They will not set up Atmospherics or any of the engines, and will disable the spare power as soon as any Engineering staff enter the round.
### Wishes, Prayers, and Faxes Admins are heavily encouraged to respond to any and all Wishes, Prayers, and Faxes. While there is no guarantee you will get exactly what you ask for, a response is highly likely.
### Game Master Requests You are allowed to AHelp to request for items, props, or other such mechanics to support a scene or narrative thread.
This also includes access to cosmetic unobtainable items, or to request the removal or relocation of unremovable items, such as during a renovation project.
### Glitch Compensations In the event of a glitch or other mechanically unintended circumstances, you may request for Admins to smooth out any consequences or otherwise assist.
### Salvage Rescue If you die while engaging with the magnet, Admins have the discretion to assist in ensuring your body is in a recoverable state. They will not send you to Medical or otherwise revive you, but are allowed to ensure the Paramedic or other such role is capable of staging a recovery.
This does not apply to Expeditions or the Red Rock Research Asteroid.
### "Admemes" (Game Mastered Events) Game Masters are not allowed to narratively define a round outside of very specific instances.
If an event would involve a majority of the crew it requires the consent of a majority of the crew to be started, as determined via an in-game vote.
Game Masters may schedule “Admeme Shifts” in advance, and these do not require a vote.
The exception to this is in the event there are no eligible Antagonist players. In such a circumstance, Game Masters will apply substitute dangers.
### Admins are Approachable If you are ever unsure of a game mechanic or ruling, or if you are unsure if your antag gimmick will be fun, you are always welcome to ask an admin with the AHelp relay. Admins are here to help keep the game fun and fair for everyone, and that includes you.
